name: standard-runtime-profiling
goal: Standard runners record actual registered operations through Harness profiling with preserved behavior, source scope, benchmark boundaries and truthful missing coverage.

evidence: Existing backend behavior tests execute real source but do not emit operation-boundary profiles. The internal adapter scaffold at9a259e6e intentionally has no transform operation and is not enabled. Real captures must bind registered source without timing entire tests or replaying effects.

Replace the generated constructor-only test with source-runner boundary coverage: sync and async operations, private-field receivers, cached Promise identity, rejection propagation, argument/result privacy, unknown source and generator deferral. Fixture metrics stay in an owned temporary sink; self-profiles time the actual transformer.
